annotations.title: Google Lyria 3 Instrumental Music & Audio Stem Composer

description: Composes studio-grade instrumental music tracks, ambient loops, and multi-instrument arrangements from genre, tempo, and mood prompts using Google Lyria 3. Use when generating musical scores, soundtrack stems, or rhythmic audio loops; for converting written text into spoken human voice narration (TTS), use synthesize_gemini_speech_audio instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'prompt' ('genre_preset' defaults to 'cinematic_synth'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (500 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

genre_preset.description: Primary acoustic or electronic genre; defaults to 'cinematic_synth' when omitted.

prompt.description: Musical style, instrumentation, BPM tempo, and harmonic mood description.

name: compose_lyria_music_track

output.description: Generated audio track payload and arrangement metadata.

success.description: True when Lyria 3 audio synthesis succeeded.
